items.description: "201 - The Bad Number" is an interactive science fiction game-book set in a post-apocalyptic Mars. In a world where only 200 people remain, each new inhabitant may hasten the end of civilization. You step into this harsh reality and confront a pivotal event—the emergence of the "bad number." Now players must make choices that will impact the future of humanity and the fate of the colony.Key Features:A branching narrative where every action influences the course of events.Immersion in an unusual dystopian world of Mars, where each decision will resonate throughout the entire history of humanity.A deep storyline with philosophical themes about time, the multiverse, and fate.Simple controls for engaging storytelling and complex decision-making.Note: The translation of the game was done using a neural network, so there may be errors.
